nodes.body:
Greptile Summary

The PR changes MXFP8 expert-parallel dispatch and combine-backward outputs from grouped tensors to plain tensor carriers while adding explicit reconstruction at grouped-MLP boundaries. - Packs MXFP8 payload and scale bytes into payload-shaped plain tensors. - Adds `mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped` for reconstructing grouped quantized views. - Updates distributed tests for caller-owned and automatically allocated carriers. - Adds guarded reconstruction paths to fused grouped MLP forward and backward execution.

Confidence Score: 4/5

The PR does not appear safe to merge because fused grouped MLP execution still processes MXFP8 carriers without activating the required reconstruction branches. The carrier-producing EP paths now return plain tensors whose bytes are not valid BF16 values, while both grouped-MLP reconstruction branches default to disabled attributes that are never assigned; the ordinary fallback therefore re-quantizes packed payload and scale bytes as if they were high-precision activations or gradients. **Files Needing Attention:** transformer_engine/pytorch/ops/fused/grouped_mlp.py, transformer_engine/pytorch/ep.py

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | transformer_engine/pytorch/ep.py | Introduces plain MXFP8 carrier allocation, packing, reconstruction, and autograd behavior for EP dispatch and combine backward. | | transformer_engine/pytorch/ops/fused/grouped_mlp.py | Adds carrier reconstruction before grouped GEMM paths, but the controlling operation flags remain unset, leaving packed carriers on the ordinary tensor path. | | tests/pytorch/distributed/run_ep.py | Updates distributed MXFP8 tests to validate plain carrier identity, storage layout, reconstruction, and numerical behavior. |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart LR A[BF16 tokens] --> B[MXFP8 quantization] B --> C[EP dispatch] C --> D[Plain tensor carrier] D --> E[mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped] E --> F[Grouped MXFP8 GEMM] F --> G[EP combine] G --> H[Plain tensor gradient carrier] H --> I[mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped] I --> J[Grouped MLP backward] ``` Reviews (4): Last reviewed commit: ["Merge branch 'main' into mxfp8\_dispatch\_..."](https://github.com/nvidia/transformerengine/commit/61cc0c4e867e7ea8eaf467df6400db4cafd7c879) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=52657455)

Closing this since we have an alternate solution with the following TE/Megatron PRs
TE: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/3701
Megatron: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8302

**Carrier reconstruction flags are unset** When an MXFP8 EP dispatch carrier reaches the fused grouped MLP, reconstruction requires `ep_mxfp8_carrier_input` to be true, but that attribute is never assigned in the repository. The forward path therefore interprets packed E4M3 data and E8M0 scales as ordinary BF16 values, producing incorrect expert activations; the corresponding unset `ep_mxfp8_carrier_grad` guard causes the same corruption for gradients. **Knowledge Base Used:** - [PyTorch Distributed/Parallel Training Support](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/pytorch-distributed.md) - [PyTorch Fusible-Operation Framework](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/pytorch-ops.md)

Wildcard imports therefore omit the function required to consume the new opaque representation, forcing callers to rely on an undeclared implementation detail. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

inline_comments.body: **Carrier reconstruction flags are unset** When an MXFP8 EP dispatch carrier reaches the fused grouped MLP, reconstruction requires `ep_mxfp8_carrier_input` to be true, but that attribute is never assigned in the repository. The forward path therefore interprets packed E4M3 data and E8M0 scales as ordinary BF16 values, producing incorrect expert activations; the corresponding unset `ep_mxfp8_carrier_grad` guard causes the same corruption for gradients. **Knowledge Base Used:** - [PyTorch Distributed/Parallel Training Support](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/pytorch-distributed.md) - [PyTorch Fusible-Operation Framework](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/pytorch-ops.md)

issue_comments.body:
Greptile Summary

The PR changes MXFP8 expert-parallel dispatch and combine-backward outputs from grouped tensors to plain tensor carriers while adding explicit reconstruction at grouped-MLP boundaries. - Packs MXFP8 payload and scale bytes into payload-shaped plain tensors. - Adds `mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped` for reconstructing grouped quantized views. - Updates distributed tests for caller-owned and automatically allocated carriers. - Adds guarded reconstruction paths to fused grouped MLP forward and backward execution.

Confidence Score: 4/5

The PR does not appear safe to merge because fused grouped MLP execution still processes MXFP8 carriers without activating the required reconstruction branches. The carrier-producing EP paths now return plain tensors whose bytes are not valid BF16 values, while both grouped-MLP reconstruction branches default to disabled attributes that are never assigned; the ordinary fallback therefore re-quantizes packed payload and scale bytes as if they were high-precision activations or gradients. **Files Needing Attention:** transformer_engine/pytorch/ops/fused/grouped_mlp.py, transformer_engine/pytorch/ep.py

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | transformer_engine/pytorch/ep.py | Introduces plain MXFP8 carrier allocation, packing, reconstruction, and autograd behavior for EP dispatch and combine backward. | | transformer_engine/pytorch/ops/fused/grouped_mlp.py | Adds carrier reconstruction before grouped GEMM paths, but the controlling operation flags remain unset, leaving packed carriers on the ordinary tensor path. | | tests/pytorch/distributed/run_ep.py | Updates distributed MXFP8 tests to validate plain carrier identity, storage layout, reconstruction, and numerical behavior. |
